thread:
Theo (Product): quick design check: usage & billing dash needs clearer spend vs tokens, and invoices must be easy for finance to export. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/nuance

Rae (Design): Posted two small mocks: Tabbed (Overview / Projects / Invoices) vs. Single-scroll with anchors. Tabs make invoices discoverable.

Jordan (Eng): Note: model-level token breakdown across many projects is costly. We can show top-5 models and offer CSV export for full detail. Add a data-staleness badge when using nightly rollups.

Tess (Finance): CSV must include tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, tokens_total, unit_price, tax, proration dates. PDFs need billing address + VAT. Downloads should be one click.

Alex (DevEx): Copy: use "Viewing: Organization 12; <org>" and label charts "Billed tokens (prompt + completion)". Export CTA: "Download invoice (CSV)". Accessibility: avoid color-only legends.

Rae (Design): I'll switch chart fills to patterns, add clear legends, keyboard nav notes, and an invoices header CTA. Posting updated frames in 6h.

Jordan (Eng): Backend endpoints proposed: `/billing/overview?range=30d`, `/billing/models?range=7d&limit=5`, `/billing/invoices?org_id=&format=csv&start=&end=`. Will require RBAC and signed URLs for downloads. ETA estimate tomorrow.

billing-bot: alert: `/billing/models` p95 increased 2025-11-03T08:12Z. Recommend rate-limit + cache.

Theo (Product): Decisions for now: Tabs (Overview/Projects/Invoices); Overview = 30d default with quick toggles 7/30/90; show top-5 models and a clear invoices tab with single-click CSV/PDF. Thanks team, will file tickets.
